_comment: Ships as 'Milestone'. Electron derives userData from the app name, so every goal/streak/project lives in %APPDATA%/Milestone/Local Storage — electron/main.cjs calls app.setName('Milestone') to pin that (npm names must be lowercase, and we don't want a lowercase profile folder). Renaming either the npm `name` or that setName call moves the profile and points the app at an empty one; it was 'rpg-quest-tracker' until 2026-07-13, and main.cjs still migrates that old profile forward on first launch.
name: milestone
_versioning: `version` below is the single source of truth. vite.config.ts reads it at build time into __APP_VERSION__ (with a build timestamp), which surfaces as the chip beside the nav-bar brand and in the Data modal — that's how you tell a fresh exe from a stale one. @electron/packager picks the same value up from here by default and stamps it into the exe's file properties. Bump it with `npm run bump:patch|minor|major` and push: .github/workflows/release.yml packages the desktop build and publishes it, pages.yml redeploys the web app, and every installed copy picks both up on its own. `npm run release:patch|minor|major` is the local equivalent, for building on this machine without going through CI. Never hand-edit it.
_repository: Read by electron/updater.cjs to find where releases are published — an install checks this repo's releases and updates itself from them.

scripts._packaging: --extra-resource copies icon.ico beside the exe. The window icon already assumed it was in resources/ and it never was; the tray needs it too, and a tray with no image is an invisible one.
scripts.package: npm run generate-icons && npm run electron:build
scripts._bumping: Bump and push; CI packages, publishes the release, and every device updates itself from it. No tag is created here — release.yml makes v<version> when it publishes, and a tag pushed ahead of the build would claim a release that doesn't exist yet.
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run package
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run package
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run package
